description: Clear misprints in the 1912 print, encoded as tei:choice with tei:sic (as printed) and tei:corr. Scope (owner decision 2026-10-14): typographical errors, wrong citation numbers and unmatched quotation marks or parentheses; archaic spellings and problems of fact or wording stay as printed and are listed in opensiddur-ai specs/asher_selichot/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md. Each entry must match exactly once in its file; see opensiddur.importer.scan.authoring.apply_corrections.

corrections.notes: Inside tei:choice/tei:abbr (refrain cue). Fix by deleting the stray ” (book cue style elsewhere is "(When, &c.)" with no quotes) or by adding an opening “ ("(“O Supreme Judge,” &c.)"). The sic inside abbr would need choice nested within abbr.

corrections.evidence: sourcetexts/feat_asher-selichot-pilot/sources/asher_selichot/proofreading/english-pass-09/adjudication.json:291 — "unmatched closing rubric quote"

corrections.evidence: sourcetexts/feat_asher-selichot-pilot/sources/asher_selichot/proofreading/english-pass-18/adjudication.json changes/16 and limitations/2 — "s359 printed When cue after wages lacks closing parenthesis"
corrections.notes: Inside tei:abbr. "(When, &c." is a substring of all twelve closed cues, so the entry matches only a text node that is exactly the unclosed cue (exact) and adds the missing ")". The service cue data recognizes both forms.
